Name: 211 Helpline
Description: Dial 211 to connect with local health and human services — food, shelter, utility assistance, and more.

Name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
Description: Free, confidential crisis support for anyone in suicidal crisis or emotional distress. Call or text 988.

Name: Calvary Baptist Church Food Pantry
Description: Church-run food pantry providing free groceries to Laurel County residents in need. Walk-in service; free of charge.
Eligibility: Resident of Laurel County; Income guidelines. Required documents: Picture ID, Proof of income, Proof of residency
Hours: Second and fourth Monday of each month, 11:00am-8:00pm (per 211 listing, last assured 02/05/2026)

Name: CVDVS London (Cumberland Valley Domestic Violence Services)
Address: London, Laurel County, Kentucky (specific street address not published on website)
Description: Cumberland Valley Domestic Violence Services, Inc. provides 24/7 safe shelter and domestic violence advocacy for residents and non-residential clients across 8 Kentucky counties; named 2025 Non-Profit of the Year by the London–Laurel County Chamber of Commerce. All staff are trained domestic violence advocates.
Eligibility: All services free of charge for participants and their dependent children; no income eligibility standards
Hours: 24/7 crisis line; safe shelter available around the clock
Intake Process: Self-referral or referral by local law enforcement or community agencies; call 1-800-755-5348

Name: Grace Health - Mountain View Clinic
Description: Primary care clinic providing compassionate, comprehensive care for all stages of life, with an on-site community pharmacy (Mountain View Pharmacy) serving Grace Health patients and the surrounding community.
Eligibility: No restrictions; bring Picture ID, private health insurance card (if insured), proof of income if uninsured or underinsured

Name: London Family Support Center (SNAP/DCBS)
Description: Local DCBS Family Support office where residents can apply for SNAP (food stamps), get EBT cards issued, and complete eligibility interviews; part of the KY Department for Community Based Services Division of Family Support.
Hours: Tue-Fri 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM (per Laurel County Health Department; call (855) 306-8959 to confirm)
What to Bring: Picture ID, Social Security card, Proof of household income

Name: Restoration Ministries Food Program
Description: Non-denominational church in Lily, KY offering community outreach including a Sack Lunch Ministry that provides free meals to hungry community members, plus Threads of Grace (winter clothing), Nursing Home Ministry, and other programs.

Name: Grace Health Levi Center Clinic
Description: Grace Health Levi Center Clinic provides comprehensive primary care for all ages, from newborns to seniors, including preventive care, wellness exams, chronic disease management, pediatric and women's health services, and sick visits. An on-site pharmacy offers prescription filling, medication counseling, drive-thru service, and free local delivery.
Eligibility: No restrictions; documents as requested when appointment is scheduled
Hours: Clinic: Mon-Fri 8:00AM-6:00PM; Pharmacy: Mon-Fri 8:00AM-6:00PM; Closed for meal break daily 1:00PM-1:30PM

Name: Christian Homeless Shelter (London KY)
Description: Good Samaritan House is the operating name of Christian Homeless Shelter of London, Inc., a Christian homeless shelter in London, Kentucky serving men, women, and families. It offers a 90-day structured program with a bed, meals, laundry, and hygiene supplies at no charge, plus Bible study, job application help, and life-skills preparation; there is an intake process and no religious test for entry.
Eligibility: Men, women, and families; no religious requirement; no drugs/alcohol during stay; random drug screens required.
Hours: Intake by appointment/phone — call 606-862-2872 for current intake hours
Intake Process: Admission at the shelter: warrant check (police report), on-site drug test, review of house rules/policies. No appointment, ID, or paperwork needed to start a conversation.

Name: Cumberland River Victims Services (Rape Crisis Center)
Description: Regional rape crisis center operated by Cumberland River Behavioral Health serving Bell, Clay, Knox, Harlan, Jackson, Laurel, Rockcastle, and Whitley counties in Southeast Kentucky; provides 24/7 crisis line, free counseling, medical/legal advocacy, and outreach to survivors of sexual assault and other crimes.
Hours: Crisis line: 24/7 — (800) 656-4673. Administrative office: (606) 528-5286 (hours not published).

Name: London KY Warming Center (City/M Ministry Partnership)
Description: City of London and Isaiah 58:10 Ministries & Outreach operate a White Flag warming shelter at 110 Burley Ave, London KY, open overnight (7pm–7am) whenever temperatures drop below 32°F. The ministry also provides sack lunches and warm meals to people in need.
Hours: Seasonal: activates during cold weather; overnight 7pm-7am when temps drop below 32°F; daytime warming center hours announced via their Facebook page
